<module id="freq_divbyodd">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by odd numbers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal that initializes the divider.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV">Odd divisor value for frequency division.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>
        // Declare the parameters and local variables here
        // Use the default values if not specified
        parameter NUM_DIV = 5;
        
        // Declare the wires and regs
        wire [31:0] cnt1, cnt2;
        reg clk_div1, clk_div2;
        reg [31:0] i;
        
        // Combinational logic for clk_div1
        assign cnt1 = (i == ((NUM_DIV >> 1) - 1)) ? 0 : i + 1;
        assign clk_div1 = (cnt1 >= ((NUM_DIV >> 1) - 1)) ? ~clk_div1 : clk_div1;
        
        // Sequential logic for clk_div1
        always @(posedge clk, negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                i <= 0;
                clk_div1 <= 0;
            end else begin
                i <= cnt1;
                clk_div1 <= clk_div1;
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic for clk_div2
        assign cnt2 = (i == ((NUM_DIV >> 1) - 1)) ? 0 : i + 1;
        assign clk_div2 = (cnt2 >= ((NUM_DIV >> 1) - 1)) ? ~clk_div2 : clk_div2;
        
        // Sequential logic for clk_div2
        always @(negedge clk, negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                i <= 0;
                clk_div2 <= 0;
            end else begin
                i <= cnt2;
                clk_div2 <= clk_div2;
            end
        end
        
        // Final output assignment
        assign clk_div = clk_div1 | clk_div2;
    </implementation>
</module>
